decision_and_early_warning.public_broadcast_sms: [URGENT ROUTE DIVERSION - RED ALERT] Primary Evacuation Camp (Dhubri Municipal Regional Relief Grounds & High-Plinth School) is INUNDATED by expanding floodwaters! DO NOT PROCEED TOWARDS LOWLANDS. All evacuees must IMMEDIATELY DIVERT to Alternative High-Ground Safe Haven: Dhubri Government Polytechnic & Engineering College Campus (Tier-3 Elevated Highland University & Technical Campus, Distance: 3.46 km). Move to high ground immediately!

recommended_tactical_actions.action: Seal off inundated Primary Camp access road. Direct all citizen evacuation convoys along elevated bypass routes to Dhubri Government Polytechnic & Engineering College Campus.
Deploy 4 NDRF battalions & SDRF motorized rescue boats to Brahmaputra Low-lying Embankments, Dhubri Central Sluice Gate Basin.
Full closure of Brahmaputra outfall sluice gates to prevent backflow into Dhubri municipal storm channels.
Activate all auxiliary heavy dewatering diesel pumps (5000 gpm); shut down inundated electrical transformers.
Enforce traffic diversions across arterial bridges and secure elevated evacuation corridors to district relief shelters.
Establish mobile medical clinics, potable water tankers, and dry ration distribution in designated cyclone/flood shelters.
